title: ControlPlaneTaskFile
description: The frontmatter of a task file, docs/delivery/tasks/<task_id>.md (SPEC §5). Knowledge and outcomes only: who is working on a task, and in which phase, is runtime state in the queue (contracts/task.schema.json). A product may require more keys (plane.json task_log.required); keys it adds are allowed.

task_id.description: The file name without .md: NNNN-kebab-slug (the number's width is plane.json ids.task.width, default 4)

status.description: pending, done or dropped. in_progress and blocked are legacy, read only, as pending (ccp tasks check warns)

kind.description: A key of plane.json task_log.kinds (default feature, refactor); read only with the architect block on (§20)

spec_refs.description: SPEC sections the task must satisfy

adr_refs.description: ADR refs: NNNN, NNNN Dn, or NNNN <section anchor> (§7)

review_point.description: The review point whose scope the task belongs to (§22.1, §22.2)

paths.description: Files or globs the task touches, declared by its writer; parallel safety reads these before the Scope In item (§16.3)

parallel.description: true: changes no file and runs beside anything; false: always alone (§16.3)

gate.description: The verifier runs the gate cold, accepting no cache (§15.3)

mac_only.description: A product's marker for a step only the operator's machine can run

renamed_from.description: The old id (or ids) when the task-log owner amended this task's id (same number)

not.description: Runtime keys never appear in a task file (SPEC §4)
